name: Bahawalpur private wagons, minibuses and paratransit
operator: Private operators (route permits by RTA Bahawalpur)

fare_rules.concessions: No passenger fare found. PCIIP profile lists TMA fees: mini-wagon local route fee Rs10 per trip and rickshaw fee Rs5 per trip (municipal levy, not a fare), c.2010.

sources.title: Punjab Cities Improvement Investment Program - Bahawalpur City Profile (Urban Unit / GHK, ADB-funded, c.2010) - Table 21 Major Urban Routes

notes: Only source with route-level info is the PCIIP city profile (c.2010): 6 'major urban routes' served by Qingqi/auto-rickshaw/mini pickups, endpoints only; it states no urban bus/van service exists. It also lists wagon stands (Mini Wagon Stand Multan Road, Three Star Mini Wagon stand, Multan Mini Wagon Stand Ahmadpuri Gate) - intercity. OSM has 2 bus relations (1777288 untagged; 5552445 'Circular Road Link') with one way each and no stops - not usable. Urdu/English searches (بہاولپور ویگن روٹ, Farid Gate/Fawara Chowk/Baghdad-ul-Jadeed wagon) found nothing else. Gap: no numbered routes or ordered stops.
